basis.en: PTF87: broad U-shaped middle, finer V-shaped ends and bow-rise from Said’s survey. Cubic station offsets are reconstructed; they have not been digitised from her line drawings. The survey’s 1.84 m maximum breadth and 1.77 m gunwale breadth are distinct measurements.
basis.mt: PTF87: nofs wiesa’ b’forma ta’ U, truf irqaq b’forma ta’ V u pruwa ogħla skont Said. L-offsets tal-istazzjonijiet huma rikostruwiti, mhux diġitizzati mill-pjanti tagħha. Il-wisa’ massima ta’ 1.84 m u dik ta’ 1.77 m fil-gunwale huma qisien differenti.

frameBasis.en: 23 numbered floors, starting at the bow. The 13.5 cm minimum between frames 9 and 10, 23 cm maximum and smaller forward gaps constrain this reconstruction. Individual spacing values are inferred, not a complete measured schedule. Sided exceptions for frames 2, 4, 15 and 20 follow Said’s thesis, p. 69.
frameBasis.mt: 23 majjiera nnumerati mill-pruwa. Il-minimu ta’ 13.5 cm bejn il-majjieri 9 u 10, il-massimu ta’ 23 cm u l-vojt iżgħar quddiem jiggwidaw ir-rikostruzzjoni. Il-qisien individwali tal-ispazjar huma stimi. Il-qisien tal-majjieri 2, 4, 15 u 20 isegwu t-teżi ta’ Said, p. 69.

citations.locator: pp. 84, 86–87 · U-to-V sections; Fig. 9; 23 frames; 13.5–23 cm spacing

scope.en: Supports the stated form or specimen observations, not these numerical offsets.
scope.mt: Jappoġġa l-forma jew l-osservazzjonijiet tal-eżemplar, mhux dawn l-offsets numeriċi.

citations.locator: pp. 69–71, 94–96 · Drawing 2 and Fig. 46; Appendix I identifies full line drawings

scope.en: Published spacing constraints and construction observations were consulted. The full line-plan images were not available for digitisation.
scope.mt: Ġew ikkonsultati l-osservazzjonijiet u l-ispazjar ippubblikati. L-immaġni sħaħ tal-linji ma kinux disponibbli biex jiġu diġitizzati.
